calculation_notes: Use Segment Activity rows where activity_view=subscription_activity and close_state=posted for the July-December 2026 analysis. Baseline window is 2026-07 through 2026-09; review window is 2026-10 through 2026-12. Join Segment Activity to Segment Lookup by segment_id. For each segment, retention gap volume is accounts_in_scope minus accounts_retained. Gap rate is gap volume divided by accounts_in_scope. Gap-rate change is review-window gap rate minus baseline-window gap rate. Save-request pressure is review-window save_requests divided by Segment Lookup account_base times 1,000. Risk score min-max normalizes review gap rate, gap-rate change, save-request pressure, and business_sensitivity across current segments, then applies weights 0.35, 0.25, 0.20, 0.20. Tie-break order is rounded score, review gap volume, business sensitivity, and segment name. Expected results: Creator Pro top score 82.9; Finance Pods lowest score 19.0; Creator Pro fastest worsening gap rate +2.7 pp; Enterprise Lite largest current gap 540; Campus Plans highest save-request pressure 49.6 per 1,000; Agency market group gap 996; top-priority count 2.
